description: Thread affinity, address pinning and asynchronous quiescence

expected.contract: Bind addressA/thread7, submit, cancel, attempt rebindB: BUSY and addressA remains retained. Complete then rebindB succeeds. Thread8 fails, and an address comparison using a separately live B reports STALE. Completion before submission or repeated completion is rejected.

verification_method: Independent state/set oracle recomputes cases.json; prose and changed conditions are assessed separately.
